scope: AuthScope's controlled demo API with synthetic Alice and Bob resources only.

results.name: Another user attempts to read the resource
results.finding: BOLA: Bob received synthetic resource 101 owned by Alice.

results.name: User attempts to modify another user's resource
User attempts to delete another user's resource
Owner retains access after the secure policy is enabled

remediation: Derive the demo actor from the controlled request context.
Check resource ownership before returning the requested object.
Retain ownership checks for all update and delete operations in every mode.
